name: query_tenant_metrics
description: Return a single named metric for the caller's tenant from a fixed registry (fact_count, active_count, disputed_count, superseded_count, retracted_count, event_count, supersede_rate, dispute_rate). Enumerated metrics only; no caller-supplied SQL or free-form aggregation.

tenant_id.description: Tenant to report on. Must equal the caller's verified tenant_id claim (enforced by Cedar).
